capabilities.evidence: Focused unit tests, native-addon tests, compiler corpus, and upstream Sage examples.
capabilities.target: Continue broadening Sage API compatibility and performance coverage.

coverage.label: Coherent exact graph-theory foundation
coverage.summary: The core Sage graph workflow is usable today, including labeled multigraph semantics, exact structural algorithms, isomorphism certificates, native Bliss/VF2 isomorphism, Bliss canonical labeling and compact automorphism generators, draggable visualization, and the complete small-graph database. The long tail of Sage algorithms remains explicit next work.

score.unit: public callable SageMath Graph methods with exact-name Sage.js implementations
score.method: Enumerated every public callable attribute of a SageMath Graph instance and intersected it with the tested Sage.js Graph method surface. Internal test assignment is reported separately as 135 of 135.

includes: diameter / radius / girth / trees / Eulerian tests
typed searchable documentation for all 135 public graph names
CI-verified graph workflows and rendered graphical reference output

capabilities.summary: Readable Sage-compatible graph objects, exact foundational algorithms, interactive plots, serialization, and the historic SQLite graph database.

Native integration checks compact generators and exact group enumeration, the SageMath scope audit measures 78 of 411 Graph methods, and every bundled graph6 record remains available as a correctness corpus.
capabilities.target: Broaden Sage graph API coverage, benchmark native frontiers on dedicated hosts, and add OGDF-class advanced routing/layout without changing public semantics.
